statement: Exact gauge-invariant width-profile theorem. In the actual positive common-spectrum block, let D=wd(X)>0 and W=wd(V). The orbit of each ordered natural endpoint pair under Laurent translation is completely classified by width, and the four actual product-mask width profile is Psi_j=(|lambda_j|D, |lambda_0|D, W-|lambda_j|D, W-|lambda_0|D). Hence on the inherited same-sign class J_sigma of distinct scalars, Psi has exact range |J_sigma|>=K/2=t^(5/9-o(1)) and singleton fibres, in both natural-endpoint branches. Compared with phi_j=min(lambda_jX), width is injective while phi is constant in the zero-anchor branch, whereas in the nonzero-anchor branch width is a fixed nonzero multiple of phi. After subtracting the known scalar-source width, every residual width equation is identically zero. The inherited divisor coordinate a+b_j is exactly |lambda_j|D, so it supplies no second independent coordinate.
